plugins.name: studio
plugins.description: A project desk for non-code work. new-project scaffolds a consistent folder skeleton + brief; scope shapes a fast first version (MVP) — fix the time budget (appetite), name the risky unknowns (rabbit holes), triage every item include/defer/split/risk-first — a plain-language take on release-shaping with no code machinery; next-piece develops the next deliverable adapted to the project's format (script, chapter, tour, issue); project-desk runs status, calendar, and a plain-language decision log. One structure for every project — a YouTube channel, a book, a set of guided tours.
